plan.title: Material PR to Split Auction Award and PO

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the PR workflow.
Enable split awards across vendors.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the requested 30-minute schedule.
Invite the two named vendors needed for the bidding and split award.
Publish the auction event.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Submit Vendor A's initial bid.
Verify Vendor A's initial bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor A's revised bid.
Verify Vendor A's revised bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's bid.
Verify Vendor B's bid was accepted.
Close the auction before awarding.
Open the comparison grid with both bidding vendors.
Verify the lowest bid ranks first, making Vendor A rank 1 at 85.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed auction.
Allocate 6 units to Vendor A.
Allocate the remaining 4 units to Vendor B.
Verify both vendors are selected and the split proposal total is 862.
Create the split-award proposal.
Submit the proposal for approval.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved split award for the PR line.

steps.note: Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase orders.
Verify that the resulting POs carry the awarded line items.
Return to the events list to verify the final lifecycle state.
Open the History tab after award and PO creation.
Verify that this event moved into History.
